D.t: Joe Neguse leads by 48.1 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 170,833 votes; a one point swing is about 1,774 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +41.8 and D +54.2. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
